get.description: Read persistent administrator state. Redirect to product admin/setup when absent, account/login after initialization. Administrator login remains an explicit separate entry. Database failure returns 503, never resets administrator state. The origin root also redirects into this product entry. Existing Connector login transaction query and POST remain on their original routes.
Query-free browser entry only; transaction_id Connector authorization stays unchanged. Select initialization or ordinary account login by persistent state, not process memory or file existence.

Uninitialized explicit setup-code-file deployment only. Private code never appears in response. Secure HttpOnly Strict __Host administrator setup cookie binds csrf. Same-origin referrer and script-free CSP with self stylesheet. Initialized sites redirect to login. No database errors are interpreted as uninitialized.

503.description: State or explicit setup file unavailable

post.description: Exact configured Host/Origin and matching setup binding/CSRF. Strict single-valued form, all fields required, no unknown fields. Protected deployment code and password confirmation required. Existing administrator cannot be overwritten, including concurrent attempts. Reuse independent administrator table, init lock, bcrypt cost 12, two hash slots and persisted five-attempt/fifteen-minute peer limit. Initialization plus audit commit atomically; no automatic login or retry. External OIDC configuration is independent and is not required to configure/log in to the administrator. Missing ordinary-account provider never grants account access.

400.description: Invalid form, confirmation, Origin or CSRF
